baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural commands to answer the caller and trust him are followed by two jussive benefits: forgiveness and protection from painful punishment.
baseline_models.mechanism: An initiating address seeks a real counter-response, trust settles that response inwardly, and the resulting relation has a covenantal shape: culpability is covered and the respondents are admitted to protective asylum from inflicted pain.

activation_trace.role: The people-group image makes the vocative a corporate address rather than an isolated appeal.
The reply image supplies the reciprocal act by which hearers answer an initiating word.
A vocal summons draws its addressees toward a response and supplies the initiating side of the exchange.
Heart-settling assent turns an audible reply into credible inward commitment.
Covering the offense while shielding its bearer from consequence supplies the first protective result.
Moral offense identifies what the promised covering addresses.
Granted asylum and defended status supply the second, outwardly protective result.
Severe punitive affliction names the danger from which asylum operates.
Pain-causing force keeps the threatened consequence concrete rather than merely adverse.

changed_reading.before: A preacher asks for belief and promises pardon and safety.
changed_reading.after: A people are summoned into a reciprocal, trust-bearing covenant in which guilt is covered and the respondents enter defended asylum from inflicted pain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence answer, trust, forgiveness, and protection can be read through the focus roots' opening, settling, covering, proximity, and asylum branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse traces a material-spatial transfer. Answering cuts an opening into a closed situation; trust settles the heart; forgiveness covers the exposed person; and protective nearness relocates the respondent under shelter.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating cut supplies the first image of making a way through obstruction.
An opened gap converts the cut into a traversable aperture within the mechanism.
Security and settled confidence mark arrival out of fear.
A preserving cover supplies the sheltering layer of the transfer.
Neighboring proximity locates the protected person beside a defending power.
Asylum turns proximity into active prevention of harm.
Punitive affliction is the exterior danger across which the transfer is measured.

changed_reading.before: Belief is followed by two abstract benefits.
changed_reading.after: The command sketches passage from obstruction and exposure through an opened response into inward settlement, covering, and defended shelter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vocative names a people, the imperatives are plural, and the focus root for people also carries rising, undertaking, and custodial images.
baseline_models.mechanism: The appeal does not merely aggregate private conversions. It calls a social body to rise to an undertaking, answer together, and adopt a shared trustworthy orientation whose protection is also addressed to the plural body.

activation_trace.role: A bonded people supplies the collective subject of the commands.
Rising with resolve turns group identity into mobilization toward an undertaking.
Guardianship and sustained care give the mobilized group a durable social task.
The demanded answer is the group's overt act of alignment.
Settled conviction supplies the shared inward orientation that keeps mobilization from being merely vocal.

changed_reading.before: Many individuals happen to receive the same invitation.
changed_reading.after: A named people is asked to reconstitute itself as a responding, trust-bearing body that rises to and keeps a common charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence contrasts repeated invocation of other-than-God with recipients that never answer and finally become enemies. That contrast makes response in the focus verse a diagnostic of viable allegiance: the authorized call establishes a relation capable of answering and protecting rather than abandoning its adherents.

activation_trace.role: The focus summons initiates the relation whose addressability is being tested.
A genuine counter-response is the demanded sign of reciprocal relation.
Calling directed elsewhere supplies the contrasted initiating address.
Repeated invocation keeps the failed address active across both the act and its calls.
The explicitly absent reply marks the other relation as nonreciprocal.
Future enmity reverses presumed patronage and shows that misaddressed devotion does not yield shelter.

structural_cues: 46:4-6 moves in order from calling other-than-God, through non-response, to the called parties' future hostility toward their callers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed answer and reversed relationship; I infer that the focus response identifies a viable protective allegiance. A live alternative is that the earlier sequence is only a polemical contrast and does not define every aspect of response.

changed_reading.before: Answering is simple compliance with a preacher's request.
changed_reading.after: Answering marks entry into an addressable God-oriented allegiance, contrasted with devotion to recipients that neither answer nor shelter and ultimately oppose their devotees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus act of trusting is extended by the later sequence from witnessed assent into steadfast straightening. The absence of anticipated fear and grief gives the focus security branch an affective duration: answer and trust begin a maintained course, not a momentary verbal event.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent anchors the initial act that context stretches over time.
Security within trust anticipates the later release from fear and grief.
Assent after testimony supplies an earlier instance of belief as responsive recognition.
Straightness and balanced continuation convert initial assent into a sustained trajectory.
Expected harm defines the future-facing disturbance that the secure course removes.
Inner roughness from grief defines the backward-facing disturbance also removed.

structural_cues: 46:13 places declaration first, straight continuation second, and freedom from fear and grief as their consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, subsequent straightening, and the paired affective negations; I infer that this sequence unfolds the duration latent in the focus command. Alternatively, the focus may require only the initiating act while 46:13 describes its later fruit.

changed_reading.before: Belief is a punctiliar assent added to a verbal answer.
changed_reading.after: Belief begins a maintained straight course whose security works across anticipated fear and remembered grief.

context_deltas.mechanism: Named forgiveness and mercy are later joined by accepting the best of deeds and actively passing beyond harmful acts. The focus covering therefore remains live but is no longer merely concealment: it participates in received return, suspended prosecution, and passage beyond damaging residue.

activation_trace.role: Preserving cover supplies the baseline material image being revised.
Shielding the offender from the offense's consequence anchors the moral application.
The same offense-shielding image appears as an identifying divine quality before the focus promise.
Tender mercy supplies the relational disposition within which covering operates.
Willing acceptance supplies positive reception rather than bare non-punishment.
Leaving off prosecution turns forgiveness into an active movement beyond liability.
The harm-bearing deed identifies what is crossed over rather than allowed to govern the outcome.

structural_cues: 46:15's explicit return toward God precedes 46:16's acceptance and passing beyond bad acts; its return root has no matching citable branch in the supplied inventory and is used only as sequence structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, acceptance, and non-prosecution around an explicit return; I infer that these disclose the mechanics of the focus promise. A live alternative is that 46:16 describes a separate evaluative scene rather than expanding this instance of forgiveness.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness hides a recorded offense so punishment does not follow.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness covers liability within mercy, receives the returning respondent, and carries that person beyond the harms that would otherwise determine the outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier punishment scene specifies abasement, while the focus grants defended status. Protection is therefore social and juridical as well as physical: asylum reverses exposure to public devaluation before judgment.

activation_trace.role: Asylum establishes a defended standing under a protector.
Security names the inward correlate of protected standing.
Abasement through contempt supplies the status-loss that asylum reverses.

structural_cues: 46:20 stages the punished before the fire and ties their punishment to prior self-exaltation, making the consequence publicly status-bearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies humiliation in the punishment scene and asylum in the focus; I infer a reversal from exposed abasement to defended standing. Alternatively, humiliation may be only one punishment subtype and not the direct contrast intended by the focus.

changed_reading.before: Protection means not undergoing bodily pain.
changed_reading.after: Protection also grants defended standing against the public abasement and loss of status carried by judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Aad sequence materializes painful punishment as an approaching atmospheric force mistaken for rain, then as annihilation that leaves only dwellings visible. This strongly activates the focus stack of cover and asylum: protection can mean shelter from a force that enters the habitat and erases its inhabitants, not only release from an abstract penalty.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover supplies the material counter-image to exposure.
Protective asylum supplies active shelter against an arriving threat.
Exposure to what descends or attacks turns the apparent rain scene into vulnerability.
Moving air gives the punishment an atmospheric carrier.
Wind as force and dominance explains how the carrier becomes overpowering.
Punitive affliction identifies the wind-borne event as consequence rather than weather alone.
Pain-causing force links the earlier event exactly to the focus threat's experiential quality.
Annihilating destruction supplies the event's terminal action on the community.
The inhabited dwelling supplies the habitat whose empty survival measures the inhabitants' loss.

structural_cues: 46:24 reverses the observers' expectation of beneficial rain, and 46:25 reports that only their dwellings remained visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior painful punishment carried by wind and the focus supplies cover and asylum; I infer that the earlier disaster remains a concrete threat-model for the promise. The materially live alternative is an exclusively post-resurrection punishment with the Aad event serving only as analogy.

changed_reading.before: Painful punishment is an unspecified future penalty.
changed_reading.after: Painful punishment retains the memory of destructive exposure entering a people's habitat, so forgiveness-as-cover and protection-as-asylum become materially vivid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence supplies a relay: a band is redirected to the recitation, hears with understanding, imposes attentive silence, remains through completion, turns toward its people, and becomes warners. The focus address is the next handoff, so responding includes entering a chain in which recipients can become carriers of the call.

activation_trace.role: The demanded reply marks the next reception point in the relay.
The summons is the relay's transmitted initiating word.
Redirection from one state and course to another brings the first listeners into range.
A mobilized supporting band supplies the first collective relay unit.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception consequential rather than acoustic.
Recitation supplies the transmissible content around which the listeners assemble.
Attentive silence is the disciplined receiving posture before transmission.
Completion closes the reception phase before the listeners move outward.
Turning orientation redirects the completed listeners toward their own people.
Warning that awakens caution converts listeners into active transmitters.

structural_cues: 46:29 orders redirection, hearing, silence, completion, return to the people, and warning immediately before the people's quoted appeal in 46:30-31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered listener-to-warner sequence; I infer that it is paradigmatic for the focus response and not merely narrative background. A live alternative keeps the singular caller restricted to the human messenger or the message while the jinn only report it.

changed_reading.before: An external preacher directly asks a passive audience to obey.
changed_reading.after: The command is the next handoff in a relay: redirected hearers receive attentively, turn toward their people as warners, and invite the next audience into the same transmissive response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report immediately before the focus describes gentle direction toward truth and an extended straight route. That sequence sharpens the spatial baseline: the answer is not only a reply at a threshold but entry onto a course, while the repeated people/straightening root binds communal identity to the route's rectitude.

activation_trace.role: An opened gap supplies the threshold through which response can become entry.
The people-group is the collective invited to take the route.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the route's guiding agency.
Reality-congruent truth supplies the route's destination and criterion.
An extended track gives the response temporal and spatial continuation.
Trace following trace makes the route reproducible for later respondents.
The paired occurrence links the addressed people with straightness and balanced alignment in the same report.

structural_cues: 46:30 first reports hearing a confirming book, then names its direction toward truth and a straight road, and 46:31 issues the response command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, truth, road, and straightness; I infer that answering means stepping onto the disclosed course. Alternatively, these phrases may describe only the book's content while response remains a discrete assent.

changed_reading.before: Answering is a discrete yes at the moment of invitation.
changed_reading.after: Answering crosses a threshold onto an extended, traceable route toward truth, with the people themselves called into straight communal alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse repeats the caller-response construction under negation and gives the inverse consequences: no escape on earth and no protecting allies. This makes the focus asylum jurisdictional and exclusive. Nonresponse is not merely loss of an optional reward; it leaves the person outside any effective counter-protection.

activation_trace.role: Granted asylum establishes the positive protected status inverted next.
The negated reply reproduces the focus hinge while reversing its outcome.
The identical kind of summons fixes the negative verse as a direct mirror rather than a loose analogy.
Repeated categorical negation removes both escape capacity and substitute protection.
Failure to outrun or slip pursuit closes the spatial escape alternative.
Allied love and support name the unavailable substitute for divine asylum.
Departure from guidance identifies nonresponse as a misdirected course, not neutral inaction.

structural_cues: 46:32 repeats the answer-and-caller wording, negates the answer, and coordinates inability to escape with absence of protectors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit syntactic and consequential mirror; I infer that the focus protection answers both inverse clauses. A live alternative is that escape and allies are cumulative consequences rather than exact semantic components of the focus asylum verb.

changed_reading.before: Respondents receive one benefit that nonrespondents simply miss.
changed_reading.after: Responding enters the only effective asylum; refusing leaves neither a route of escape nor an alternate protector.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verses move from the power to restore the dead to a truth-question before the fire and then to personally experienced punishment. The focus protection therefore spans a judgment horizon in which death is not escape and pain is not a metaphor: the threatened state becomes encountered and undergone.

activation_trace.role: Asylum anchors the protection whose horizon context extends beyond present life.
Pain-causing force anchors the experiential quality later made explicit.
Effective power to bring an act about supplies the capacity behind restoration and judgment.
Loss of life names the boundary that divine capacity is said to overcome.
Truth matching reality marks judgment as disclosed fact rather than warning alone.
Direct experience and trial convert the announced consequence into an undergone state.
Punitive affliction is the object of that direct experience and reconnects it to the focus threat.

structural_cues: 46:33 explicitly asks about restoring the dead; 46:34 then stages recognition before the fire and commands experience of punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restoration capacity followed by encountered judgment; I infer that the focus asylum spans this eschatological sequence. The Aad-like worldly calamity remains a live, nonexclusive horizon.

changed_reading.before: Protection concerns an unspecified danger that might occur in ordinary history.
changed_reading.after: Protection reaches through death into an encountered judgment where the threatened punishment becomes personally experienced, while worldly disaster remains a parallel possibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing instruction pairs restrained endurance and fixed resolve with refusal to hasten, then compresses the apparent delay when the promised event is seen. This revises response from a one-time utterance into durable enactment: trust must hold its course through an interval whose felt scale later collapses.

activation_trace.role: The immediate reply is the initiating act whose duration context revises.
Settled confidence supplies the state capable of enduring delay.
Holding the self against panic supplies the persistence required after the initial answer.
A decisively bound intention prevents the response from dissolving under delay.
Continuing along a fixed purpose turns decision into maintained travel.
Haste supplies the counter-pressure that patience and trust must resist.
Delay and slow remaining supply the interval whose apparent length is later compressed.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies closure to the interval of sustained response.

structural_cues: The closing comparison reduces their prior remaining to one hour of a day; the supplied س و ع inventory lacks a citable hour branch, so this temporal compression is retained only as structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, resolve, non-haste, delayed remaining, and arrival; I infer that these are the lived duration of the focus answer. Alternatively, 46:35 may address only the messenger's patience and leave the audience's response punctiliar.

changed_reading.before: Response is complete once the audience says yes and assents.
changed_reading.after: Response begins with assent but must persist as restrained, resolved trust through delay until the promised endpoint arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant split mapping from the focus response root into gathering and selection rather than ordinary reply. It remains anchored in the focus response form and is activated by the immediately preceding assembled band and recitation-as-gathering. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary resonance, never as the lexical replacement for answering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The response imperative is plural and addressed to a people immediately after a band has assembled around recitation and returned collectively.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of collecting turns response into consolidation of persons and commitments.
Selection and drawing near add an exploratory sense of being gathered into a chosen responding body.
The named people supplies the collective that could be gathered by the response.
A mobilized band supplies the contextual social shape that activates collection.
Gathering around the recited content gives the exploratory collection a visible center.

changed_reading.before: Each hearer independently returns a verbal answer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, answering also gathers and selects the hearers into a newly consolidated responding people.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the focus protection root through its non-dominant recompense and fracture-repair mapping. It remains anchored in the protection verb and gains support from the surah's language of work and full settlement. Downstream prose should qualify it as a reparative-economic echo within asylum, not claim that protection literally means wages or bone-setting here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The protection result follows commanded response and trust, while the focus also names offenses whose damaging consequence requires repair.

activation_trace.role: The split-root return for work gives protection an exploratory recompensive resonance.
Repairing a fracture, even with residual crookedness, supplies a bodily model for restored but marked safety.
Offense supplies the break in relation and exposure that reparative protection addresses.
Return attached to work activates the recompensive side of the split mapping.
Full settlement without deficit gives the exploratory recompense a completed accounting frame.

changed_reading.before: Protection is only a shield placed between a person and punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, asylum also resonates as a fully rendered, reparative return that mends the respondent's offense-created exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the caller root's form-distant split into forceful pushing and raising the fallen. It remains anchored in the focus caller and in the plural command to a people, with the redirected mobilized band immediately before it. Downstream prose should render pressure and recovery as an imagistic undercurrent, not assert coercion as the caller noun's direct sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A caller addresses a people with plural imperatives after a band has been redirected, mobilized, and sent back toward its own people.

activation_trace.role: The split-root forceful push gives the summons an exploratory pressure toward decisive movement.
A call that raises the stumbling supplies recovery and renewed standing rather than pressure alone.
Rising with resolve gives the pushed or raised people a communal direction of action.
Redirection from state to state supplies the contextual turn that activates mobilization.
The mobilized supporting band shows communal movement already occurring before the focus appeal.

changed_reading.before: The caller offers information that hearers may calmly accept.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call exerts recovering pressure that gets a stumbling or dispersed people on its feet and moving together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the punishment root's branch of being uncovered to the sky and opposes it to the focus roots for cover and asylum. It remains strongly anchored by the nearby wind-borne destruction scene. Downstream prose should call this a material analogy for vulnerability, not redefine every occurrence of punishment as weather exposure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places preserving cover and asylum directly against painful punishment, permitting a cover-versus-exposure polarity.

activation_trace.role: Preserving cover supplies one pole of the material reversal.
Asylum turns cover into defended shelter rather than passive concealment.
Being uncovered beneath the sky supplies the surprising exposure pole within the threatened root.
Exposure to an oncoming atmospheric event gives the focus polarity a concrete contextual scene.
Overpowering wind supplies the force to which the uncovered community is vulnerable.
Annihilating destruction supplies the consequence of remaining exposed.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is only pain inflicted by a judge.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, punishment is also uncovered exposure to an overpowering force, while forgiveness and asylum provide preserving cover.

strongest_changes: The 46:29-30 sequence turns the focus command into the next handoff in a listener-to-warner relay.
The direct negative mirror in 46:32 makes protection exclusive asylum: nonresponse leaves neither escape nor an alternate protecting ally.
The acceptance and passing-beyond sequence in 46:16 revises forgiveness from concealment alone into received return and active non-prosecution.
The wind and emptied-dwellings scene in 46:24-25 materializes painful punishment as destructive exposure against which cover and asylum operate.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots form an unusually coherent reply-to-asylum chain, while their split inventories preserve live but contained resonances of gathering, communal mobilization, reparative recompense, and cover opposed to exposure. The adjacent narrative also shows the callers first becoming listeners, so the command reads as a social relay rather than a static proposition.
remaining_uncertainties: The singular caller may foreground the human messenger, the divinely authorized message, or the current bearer within the relay; the packet keeps all three plausible.
Protection may target Aad-like worldly destruction, post-resurrection judgment, or both horizons without forcing a choice.
The preposition before sins leaves the exact scope of forgiven offenses unresolved because it has no root inventory in the packet.
The gathering, forceful-mobilization, and reparative-recompense readings depend on non-dominant split roots and must remain exploratory resonances rather than lexical claims.
